description: Measure which brands AI names or recommends across topics, markets, or engines. Public measures: answers, questions, share_named, share_recommended, listing_share, concentration, share_citing, page_type_mix, hedge_mix, own_site_citations, descriptor_words, causal_funnel (concentration takes no by). Rows include answer and question counts. Shares include a 95% range when available. For cited pages use search_cited_pages. Free. More arguments: resolve_ids {"kinds":["argument"],"q":["query_metrics"]}.

allBrands.description: with by brand: rank every brand named, not the 50 named most (signed in)

brands.description: with by brand: only these brands' rows, against each other in the same answers (in place of the most named)

by.description: up to 3 of brand, topic, market, question, engine, surface_class, place, country, day, week, month, site, page, page_type, search_query, descriptor, claim, axis, versus_brand, or facet:<key>

compare.description: prior: the window of equal length before, with significance; none: no comparison. Write the value bare, compare: prior, with no quotes inside the string

explain.description: false: leave out the one-sentence note (data.note). change (with subject, a share and compare prior): why each share moved, split into the same questions and the question mix, with engine model changes

filter.description: which answers count; window is a separate argument, not part of filter

brand.description: brd_ ids; with brandRule, which answers count

brandRule.description: default named; not_recommended keeps judged answers recommending none of the filter brands; warned filters to answers flagged with facet mention.advised_against

country.description: ISO country codes the question was asked from; an answer asked with no place set counts as US

engine.description: surface ids (resolve_ids with kinds: ["surface"] lists them); without engine or surfaceClass, the counted engines

market.description: Industry or category markets. For countries use country, and for cities use place.

place.description: plc_ ids (resolve_ids finds them): the place a question is about, with the places under each (a region holds its cities). "all": every place, in place of a local subject's area. A country code here reads as filter.country for one release

scope.description: default all: public plus this workspace's own; own: only the answers this workspace bought; tracked: its own answers and those about the questions, topics and brands it watches with the track tool (not the brands it added in the app); public: public answers only; index: the answers parse.gl's public pages count, which a logged-out call always reads

site.description: domains or site: ids of cited sites

text.description: Full-text search over answer text: keywords, "exact phrases", AND/OR/NOT, NEAR/n, prefix*. A call reads at most the first 100,000 matches (20,000 in search_answers) before the brand filter and the rest apply: a brand filter does not narrow it, so a common word over a long window can miss a brand's answers; narrow by window, topic, market or engine

history.description: answers past 90 days, $0.001 each once: auto (default) a sample worth up to a quarter of the month's budget, at most $5; all, every answer within the budget; free, none, with each sample's cost

sort.description: a measure or a by dimension; "<name> asc" or "<name> desc"

subject.description: brd_ id the shares are about; or group by brand. With no filter it reads the brand's own markets (up to three) pooled, named in context.marketsRead: pass filter.market for one market's number

topPerGroup.description: with two dimensions in by: the first N rows within each value of the first

window.description: default the last 28 days; "last" or from/to

name: query_metrics
title: Query metrics over AI answers
